facts.claim: The population of Lonauli in 1901 was 6,686, and a railway reservoir about 2 miles south provides a fair supply of drinking water.
facts.quote: Population (1901), 6,686. A railway reservoir, about 2 miles to the south, affords a fair supply of drinking-water.

facts.claim: Lonauli has three hotels and is frequented by visitors from Bombay during hot months because of its temperate climate.
facts.quote: There are three hotels, and the place is much frequented by visitors from Bombay in the hot months owing to its temperate climate.

facts.claim: The municipality of Lonauli, established in 1877, had an average income of Rs. 11,300 during the decade ending 1901.
facts.quote: The municipality, established in 1877, had an average income during the decade ending 1901 of Rs. 11,300.
